why: Figure B is figure A flipped top to bottom (a mirror on a horizontal line): the curved arrow moves from the top to the bottom but still points to the right. Flip C the same way: a straight arrow in the middle pointing right stays exactly the same. So the answer is option 4, which looks just like C. Option 2 is wrong because a top-bottom flip does not change left and right.
trick: In a top-bottom mirror, left and right never change. A horizontal arrow on the middle line stays the same.
